verdict.rationale: Datalab documents rate limits (400 req/min on the Team plan), publishes per-document limits with page_range segmentation, and offers webhooks for async job completion. It steers "extremely high volume" users toward paid on-prem deployment rather than the hosted API. missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch submission endpoint, published throughput or latency (SLA) figures for predictable throughput, and evidence of million-page batch runs on the hosted API.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I push high-volume batches — millions of pages — with documented rate limits and predictable throughput

citations.quote: For documents exceeding these limits, use the page_range parameter to process in segments
Webhooks provide real-time notifications when your document processing jobs complete, eliminating the need for continuous polling.
